market_summary: FX pairs (EURUSD, GBPUSD) and XAUUSD are trading in bearish structural alignments below VWAP and EMA50 during London session, but are currently consolidating or testing key support boundaries without high-volume RVOL confirmation. US100 remains in a strong uptrend testing session highs near its upper ATR band, while BTCUSD shows minor bearish CVD divergence near overhead resistance. All instruments present sub-optimal immediate entry triggers, favoring patience for retracements or clear breakout volume.

signals.rationale: Price is inside the Value Area (VAL 4040.95 to VAH 4059.52) and slightly below POC 4044.58. CVD is NEUTRAL (-1.36) with negative slope (-0.81). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price sits below flat VWAP (4048.69) and EMA50 (4050.41), consolidating mid-channel between ATR bands with low volume (RVOL 0.862, no yellow spikes). No clean sweep or rejection of Session High (4066.79) or Session Low (4026.41). Lack of momentum or breakout trigger warrants a HOLD.

Price is inside Value Area (VAL 1.11315 to VAH 1.11614) and below POC 1.11374. CVD is NEUTRAL (-679) with positive slope. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is trading below VWAP (1.11506) and EMA50 (1.11519), testing the lower ATR band (1.11321) near Session Low (1.11307). RVOL is low (0.57) without volume confirmation. Price is stuck at the bottom of the value area without clear breakdown volume or sharp rejection wick. Prefer HOLD.

Price is below VAL (1.33186) and below POC (1.33473). CVD is NEUTRAL (-1,068) with positive short-term slope. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is below VWAP (1.33303) and EMA50 (1.33327), pushing against lower ATR band (1.33085) and Session Low (1.33070) / Prev Low (1.33119). RVOL is 0.523 (no yellow bars). Although price is expanding below VAL, it is extended into lower ATR band without strong CVD agreement or high volume. Best to wait for consolidation or retest.
signals.level_event: test of Session Low / Prev Low support

signals.rationale: Price is inside Value Area (VAL 28047.89 to VAH 28298.66) but near the top, above POC 28118.76. CVD is BULLISH (+9.09) though short-term slope is slightly negative (-0.47). Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is in a clean uptrend above rising VWAP (28099.54) and EMA50 (28109.18), hugging the upper ATR band (28296.81) right near Session High (28298.66). US100 volume rarely prints RVOL > 2.0; however, buying directly into session high resistance / upper ATR band without a pullback presents poor risk-reward. Standard discipline dictates HOLD for pullback to EMA20/VWAP.

Price is currently slightly above VAH (73848.10) and above POC (73660.40). CVD is BEARISH (-0.04) showing divergence against price elevation. Session is LONDON_SESSION. Price is holding above VWAP (73678.23) and EMA50 (73740.71), oscillating mid-channel between baseline EMA20 (73813.98) and upper ATR band (74219.79). RVOL is 1.098 (no yellow spike). Visual chart shows upper wicks rejecting near S/R (73975.30) and Session High (74085.20). CVD divergence and resistance overhead favor HOLD.
